tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List the blockchain networks AlgoVoi supports, with asset IDs, decimals, and CAIP-2 identifiers. Offline tool — no API call.

tools.name: verify_rfc9421
tools.description: Verify an RFC 9421 signed HTTP message (Ed25519 + RFC 9530 Content-Digest) OFFLINE — no API call, no network. Support tool for the agent ecosystem: check whether a signed agent-to-agent message is authentic and untampered. Supply the envelope and the signer key you EXPECT (public_key_hex or did_key); a key inside the envelope is never trusted. Returns {valid, errors, checked}.

method.description: HTTP method of the signed message (e.g. POST).

path.description: The request path the signature covers.

headers.description: Message headers incl. Signature-Input, Signature, Content-Digest.

body_b64.description: Base64 of the raw message body.

public_key_hex.description: Expected signer Ed25519 public key, hex (32 bytes).

did_key.description: Alternative to public_key_hex: the signer's did:key.

require_content_digest.description: Require a covered Content-Digest; default true.

expected_tag.description: If set, require this signature tag.

max_age_seconds.description: If set, enforce freshness within this window.

now.description: Unix time to evaluate freshness against (testing).

tools.name: explain_rfc9421
tools.description: DIAGNOSE an RFC 9421 signed HTTP message OFFLINE (no API call, no network). Bring a broken or failing signed request and get the exact canonical signing base, the Content-Digest recompute, the covered components, and a plain diagnosis of what is wrong. Read-only and public-data-only; the MCP face of the AlgoVoi RFC 9421 clinic. Returns {valid, errors, signature_base, content_digest, covered_components, diagnosis, links, citation}.

method.description: HTTP method of the signed message (e.g. POST).

path.description: The request path the signature covers.

headers.description: Message headers incl. Signature-Input, Signature, Content-Digest.

body_b64.description: Base64 of the raw message body.

public_key_hex.description: Signer Ed25519 public key, hex (32 bytes), so the signature can be checked.
